description: Sets field values on an existing Sitecore item over the Authoring and Management API. Only the fields named are touched; set reset true on a field to return it to its template's standard value instead of writing a value. Supply exactly one of id or path.

database.description: The database holding the item. Defaults to master.

fields.description: The fields to change. At least one.

reset.description: When true, clear the item's own value so the template's standard value applies again.

value.description: The value to write. Omit when reset is true.

id.description: The item's GUID. Supply this or path.

language.description: The language version to write, e.g. 'en'.

path.description: The item's full path. Supply this or id.

version.description: The item version to write. Defaults to the latest.

name: authoring-update-item
